card.name: Words just before a threshold number
card.fires_on: Small words or nouns right before a numeric limit, minimum or typical amount, such as 'tip amount', 'reported at', 'needs to be at' or 'below 2°C'. The number comes next.

modes.label: Before a typical or minimum amount
modes.description: A noun or small word leads into a standard or required figure.
modes.example: A common tip<< amount>> is 15% of the cost

modes.label: Before a dose or level limit
modes.description: A linking word precedes a level at which an effect occurs or a cutoff applies.
modes.example: Acute toxic reactions in humans have been reported<< at>> doses as low as 100

modes.label: Before a cutoff value
modes.description: A word in a sentence about what counts as enough or significant.
modes.example: A z-score change <0.5 SD is considered not<< clinically>> significant.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words meaning 'at least' or a minimum threshold.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before a number that sets a minimum, limit or typical level.
